# PVE Self-Hosting and Resources Checklist: Supervised Autonomous Loop

**Purpose**: Formal reviewer gate for self-hosting topology, 16 GB Proxmox VE capacity, concurrency,
resource measurement, and weaker evaluation-mode requirements
**Created**: 2026-08-31
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) and [PVE deployment target](../../../docs/architecture/pve-deployment.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Topology and Sovereignty

- [x] CHK001 Are control plane, PostgreSQL/artifacts, dedicated runner VM, and external inference boundaries stated without making a local GPU or external SaaS control plane mandatory? [Completeness, PVE Deployment §Production-oriented topology]
- [x] CHK002 Is authoritative state ownership local and independent from runner loss, browser connection, and provider session? [Consistency, Constitution §III/XVI; Spec §FR-025]
- [x] CHK003 Is all-in-one evaluation mode explicitly labeled weaker isolation, loopback-only, and unsuitable for untrusted repositories? [Clarity, PVE Deployment §Deployment modes]
- [x] CHK004 Is split mode the production-oriented target without claiming it is implemented in slice 001? [Clarity, Spec §Exclusions; PVE Deployment §Deployment modes]

## Capacity and Scheduling Quality

- [x] CHK005 Are one supervisor, one active project, three personas, four specialists, three default cognitive runs, five-run ceiling, one default runner job, and conditional two-job ceiling consistent across artifacts? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004/FR-014; PVE Deployment §Reference workload]
- [x] CHK006 Are identity counts distinguished from consuming runtime/process/resource counts? [Clarity, Organization Model §Policy limits]
- [x] CHK007 Are control-plane and runner memory/CPU figures expressed as measured planning envelopes rather than reservations or unconditional support claims? [Clarity, Plan §Constraints; PVE Deployment §Planning envelope]
- [x] CHK008 Are CPU, memory, process, disk, time, network, and optional GPU resource units defined as scheduler inputs with discovery evidence? [Completeness, Spec §FR-040; Plan §Performance and Resource Validation]
- [x] CHK009 Is a second runner job prohibited until the runner capacity probe supplies the required evidence? [Measurability, Spec §SC-012; Open Decisions §OD-011]

## Performance and Recovery Evidence

- [x] CHK010 Are event latency, command acknowledgement, restart time, memory high-water mark, queue delay, outbox lag, and runner utilization all defined as capacity outputs? [Completeness, Plan §Performance and Resource Validation]
- [x] CHK011 Are p95 targets specified separately at three and five cognitive executions, with a repeatable constant fixture workload? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006]
- [x] CHK012 Is host headroom for PVE, Linux, storage, filesystem cache, and spikes protected rather than allocated to Moonshift by assumption? [Coverage, PVE Deployment §Planning envelope]
- [x] CHK013 Are backup/restore storage and downtime requirements included in the reference host validation rather than treated only as a later release concern? [Coverage, Plan §Migration, Backup, and Restore]
- [x] CHK014 Are rootless runtime limitations on cgroups v1, subordinate IDs, networking, storage driver, and filesystem translated into fail-closed runner registration requirements? [Completeness, Research §R-007]
- [x] CHK015 Is the 16 GB result clearly scoped to deterministic remote-inference simulation rather than arbitrary real repositories/providers? [Clarity, Spec §Assumptions/SC-012]

## Notes

- Independent requirements review accepted all 15/15 items on 2026-08-31.
- A checked item does not certify hardware capacity; only the future evidence run can do that.
- `$speckit-implement` reads checklist state as a gate and must not modify markers.
